title: Validate JSON After Edit
summary: A Claude Code hook that parses every edited .json file and sends the parser error back to the agent when the syntax is broken.
description: One missing comma in package.json or a data file breaks builds in confusing ways. This PostToolUse hook runs the built-in JSON parser on any .json file the agent just changed and reports the exact parser message if it fails.
Files that allow comments, such as tsconfig and jsconfig, are skipped so they do not raise false alarms.
useWhen: Edit package.json or config files with an agent
Maintain data files like fixtures and translations
Catch trailing commas right after they appear
Avoid a failed install caused by a typo

hook.command: node -e "process.on('uncaughtException',()=>process.exit(0));let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)||{}}catch(e){process.exit(0)}const i=j.tool_input||{};const f=String(i.file_path||'');const fs=require('fs');const rd=()=>{try{return fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')}catch(e){return null}};const base=require('path').basename(f).toLowerCase();if(!base.endsWith('.json')||/^(tsconfig|jsconfig)/.test(base)||base.includes('devcontainer'))process.exit(0);const t=rd();if(t===null)process.exit(0);try{JSON.parse(t.charCodeAt(0)===65279?t.slice(1):t)}catch(e){console.error('Invalid JSON in '+f+': '+e.message+'. Fix the syntax (commas, quotes, brackets) and save again.');process.exit(2)}process.exit(0)})"

example.prompt: Add a lint script to package.json.
example.result: The edit leaves a trailing comma. The hook reports the parser error with its position and the agent repairs the file.

faq.question: Does it check JSON with comments?
faq.answer: tsconfig, jsconfig and devcontainer files are skipped because their format allows comments. Other .json files must be strict.

faq.question: Does it need any package?
faq.answer: No. It uses the JSON parser that ships with Node.

access: Reports parse errors; changes no files
